selection: First six food-register Restaurant/Cafe/Canteen records with coordinates per area, selected before Overture matching; ten official-address salon branches.
limitations: 40 deliberate QA cases are not a random sample or a London completeness estimate.
Register presence is not current opening proof.
Fuzzy name/proximity is candidate discovery only; no automatic merging or branch repair.
disposition: Native inventory admission only; unique-business counts and inventory percentiles remain unavailable until entity/cohort admission. No exhaustive competitor claim.
